turns: What are the top 5 genres by sales revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
